trial_court: Court of 1st Addl. Distt. Judge, Lakhnadon, District Seoni (Case No.RCS HM No.48/2022)
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Wife/applicant prayed for transfer of petition under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure from the Court of 1st Addl. Distt. Judge to Family Court, Seoni.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a petition to another court if the applicant is facing difficulty in participating in the proceedings.
legal_principles.held: It would be convenient for her to attend proceedings in the Family Court at Seoni.
cited_cases: Santoshi Rai vs Prashant Rai, (2023) X SCC Y
Tejalben v. Mihirbhai Bharatbhai Kothari, (2016) 3 SCC 69

legal_principles.principle: The court may consider the convenience of the applicant in deciding a petition transfer.
legal_principles.held: It would be convenient for her to attend proceedings in the Family Court at Seoni.
cited_cases: Ruchi Rawat v. Principal Judge, Family Court, Etah and another, (2022) SCC Online SC 2036
Manjula Singh Chouhan v. Vishal Singh Chouhan, (2019) 13 SCC 660

outcome.final_order: Petition transferred from the Court of 1st Addl. Distt. Judge, Lakhnadon, District Seoni to Family Court, Seoni.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition for divorce proceedings
advising on court attendance and participation in matrimonial disputes
assisting with legal proceedings in Family Courts
